The '''Gligger system''' was a part of the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Battle of Gligger]]<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was fought in the vicinity of the Gligger [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Battlenamia">{{Battlenamia|event=the [[Battle of Gligger]]|system=Gligger system|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gligger system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
